figurative_meaning_en: To do something convenient or any activity rather than remaining idle
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সারাদিন বসে আছে, একটা কিছু করুক।
একটা কিছু না করলে সময় নষ্ট হয়ে যাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: He's been sitting around all day; he should do something.
If you don't do something, time will be wasted.
note: This expression encourages proactive behavior in daily life.
